events.title: Codex supervisor (interactive): ACCEPT
events.detail: Recommend ACCEPT under the stated simulation SOP after all five valid 118 h QC records returned passing. Oxygen declined but remained above the defined threshold through the endpoint. Report limited oxygen-transfer headroom, declining viability and higher media use as process limitations; do not generalize this simulated acceptance to real manufacture.

request.rationale: The online readings do not identify a fault. Update sampled glucose, lactate, viable-cell density and independent pH before making a process intervention.

Lactate is rising and glucose is declining while independent pH remains normal. Increase perfusion moderately and verify delivery to distinguish equipment behavior from a possible metabolic-demand change.
Delivery verification is normal. A fresh metabolic result can show whether demand remains elevated despite correct equipment delivery; avoid treating a lactate trend as differentiation.

Correct delivery is verified, yet lactate rose to 2.291 g/L and glucose fell to 4.6223 g/L. Increased biological demand is a supported explanation, not evidence of differentiation. Increase dilution to 10 mL/h and check the response.
Measure whether the higher perfusion setting has contained the metabolic trend without a further unsupported equipment intervention.

Despite normal delivery and increased perfusion, lactate is 2.4749 g/L and viability is declining. Use the permitted 12 mL/h maximum, reassess at 96 h, and do not infer phenotype or genomic quality from metabolism.

Oxygen has declined to about 34% while remaining above the simulation excursion threshold. Check current viability and metabolism; maximum permitted perfusion does not establish adequate quality or unlimited oxygen-transfer capacity.

Perfusion is already at its allowed maximum. The declining oxygen trajectory indicates limited remaining transfer headroom; no validated oxygen-transfer intervention is available in this action set. Continue the documented campaign, retain the full oxygen history, and withhold acceptance pending near-endpoint measurements and QC.
Collect late evidence of viability and metabolism alongside the independent QC channels. Preserve the declining oxygen trajectory for final review; no assay request itself establishes a pass.

The endpoint has no recorded oxygen-threshold crossing, but viability declined and separate QC results are still pending. Maintain hold while those measurements finish; favorable current pH cannot replace them.
